First release of Yaptic: hold a key, talk, release, and your words are typed
wherever your cursor is. Speech recognition runs locally with Whisper on
Apple Silicon; cleanup with an LLM is optional.

## What's in it

- Push-to-talk on ⌥ Space (changeable in settings), with a small status pill.
- Local Whisper large-v3-turbo transcription (downloaded on first run,
  about 550 MB, checked against a pinned SHA-256).
- Indonesian, English, and mixed speech, plus a custom dictionary.
- Optional cleanup through Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint,
  including local Ollama or LM Studio. Off by default.
- Pastes at the cursor in any app and restores your clipboard afterwards.

## Known limitations

- macOS on Apple Silicon only.
- Not signed with an Apple Developer ID: right-click → Open on first launch,
  or run `xattr -cr /Applications/Yaptic.app`.
- The shortcut needs a non-modifier key, so Fn alone or Right Option alone
  isn't supported yet.
- Auto-detecting the language adds about a second per dictation on an M1;
  choosing Indonesian or English is faster.
- Cloud cleanup needs internet; without it the raw transcript is pasted.

## Verify your download

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt
gh attestation verify Yaptic_0.1.0_aarch64.dmg --repo iniandrew/yaptic
```
